title: EffectCraft motion authoring source reuse assessment

license_and_notices.declared_license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (workspace and both selected crate manifests)
license_and_notices.mit_option: MIT License; exact text copied from upstream LICENSE-MIT to notices/LICENSE-MIT
license_and_notices.notice: Root NOTICE copied to notices/; preserve it and any applicable ATTRIBUTION.md/per-file attribution when copying any additional EffectCraft material.
license_and_notices.trademark_limit: EffectCraft NOTICE excludes ArtCraft name/wordmark/logos and docs/brand material from the software license.
license_and_notices.third_party_limit: This review did not audit complete dependency or asset attribution closure. No code was copied into this candidate package.

candidate.decision: Do not copy the EffectCraft interpolation solver or time crate. Reuse a narrow property-key editing interaction contract in Poet, backed by Poet/Qualia-owned time, typed values, history, authorization and render operators.
reusable_classes: Authored per-property key insertion/editing at an explicit playhead time and bound property identity
Independent incoming/outgoing interpolation state (linear, hold, Bezier) with per-dimension temporal speed and influence as editable authored parameters
Key-icon half classification (left/right segment interpretation) as a view-model derived from that authored state
Shared selected property/track target between timeline gestures, property controls, menus/shortcuts and agent commands
not_reusable_as_is: EffectCraft Tick/timebase types: separate exact media-time domain and arithmetic; Poet must bind to its admitted time authority
EffectCraft Value enum and lerp: embeds EffectCraft-specific geometry, color, text and layer-reference models

EffectCraft ease_progress, spatial Bezier arc-length evaluator and property interpolation: substantial numeric behavior duplicates/overlaps existing Qualia animation/render ownership and needs exact contract adjudication before any adoption
EffectCraft UI shell, Boa expression runtime, standalone MCP/CLI/session, renderer/GPU ownership, project serializer or command authority

existing_owner_comparison.qualia_vibe_curves: Cubic/standard easing evaluator exists at animation/curves.rs, but this scanned module is a normalized curve library, not key storage or property editing.
existing_owner_comparison.qualia_vibe_timeline_family: animation/families/timeline.rs defines three sample presets; it is not a multi-track authored document/timeline model.
existing_owner_comparison.qualia_image_source_over: qualia-core-db hypermedia_authoring/image_source_over.rs is a narrow encoded-RGBA source-over helper and does not supply an editorial track model.
existing_owner_comparison.qualia_spectral_operator: qualia-core-db render/spectral_operator.rs owns physical/spectral rendering operations; do not route ordinary keyframe interpolation or display easing through spectral operators.
existing_owner_comparison.effectcraft_property_effect_stack: Prior bounded engine-authoring review traces property/effect-instance IDs and command-backed edits/history. It does not qualify a selected effect kernel; use as an integration-seam map only.

candidate.minimal_slice_recommendation: Implement one Poet-owned keyed-property interaction vertical slice: add a typed key at explicit time, edit its in/out ease metadata, reflect key-half state in a native timeline, and route both pointer/UI and agent edits through the same admitted intent/history boundary. Reuse the described EffectCraft semantics only where they map cleanly; keep evaluation with the existing selected Qualia operator. No copy-ready engine implementation is recommended by this limited review.
candidate.integration_status: Recommendation only; no code extracted, no canonical source edited, and no Poet implementation or runtime acceptance established.

limits: The three body files are source readings, not executed behavior or tests.
The Qualia comparison inspected only the listed four selected modules and prior saved reports; it is not a nine-root completeness audit.
The existing EffectCraft route report covers a selected composition/keyframe/effect/property/history/save path, not all effect kernels or complete dependency closure.

No claim that EffectCraft track insertion is independent of its time crate: Keyframe.time is EffectCraft Tick and its evaluator converts Tick to seconds. The UI-level command concept is separable; the current serialized/runtime model is not drop-in separable without an adapter.
